subject: Pen test report: scope clarifications, evidence ask, and delivery timeline
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@cyphersec.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@brighttrade.com
Date: 2026-11-20T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Scheduling + scoping questions for BrightTrade pentest

Hi Evelyn / Rishi,

Thanks again for engaging CypherSec for BrightTrade's external penetration test. We're kicking off scheduling and have a couple of quick clarifying questions so the engagement and deliverables match your compliance goals (SOC 2 / SIG):

- Confirmed scope: external web app (prod and staging) plus VPN ingress and partner API endpoints (/payments/*). Any additional infrastructure to include?
- Blackbox vs greybox: do you want credentials for authenticated routes, or should we proceed blackbox for the first pass?
- Evidence needs: do you require an executive summary + full technical report + vulnerability repro steps as separate artifacts? Some customers also request a signed remediation attestation.
- Logistics: preferred window is Dec 1–7 for active testing (we'll need short-lived creds for staging). Is that workable?

Attached is our standard test plan template — we can adapt if you have specific exclusions. Once we confirm, we'll provision access instructions and finalize the calendar.

Thanks,
Oliver Grant
Principal Consultant | CypherSec Ltd
security@cyphersec.com
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@cyphersec.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T10:37:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling + scoping questions for BrightTrade pentest

Oliver — thanks. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Scope: include prod web app (payments.brighttrade.com), staging, and the partner API endpoints you noted. Do NOT attempt internal corporate AD / employee laptops — those are out of scope.

- Greybox for authenticated routes is preferred: we'll provide time-limited service accounts for staging and a test user for prod with payment amounts blocked. Full creds instructions to follow.

- Deliverables: we require (1) Executive summary for auditors, (2) Full technical report with PoCs / repro steps, (3) CSV export of findings that maps to our internal tracker, and (4) a signed remediation attestation once high/critical items are addressed. Please ensure your report maps each finding to CVSS where applicable.

- Timeline: Dec 1–5 is acceptable for active testing; please avoid Dec 6–7 (release window). If you need additional time, flag ASAP.

Also, for SOC 2 and SIG intake we will need a short evidence bundle: log excerpts, screenshots of repros, and your test checklist (your test plan + test cases executed). Please mark any screenshots that contain PII and redact if needed.

I'll loop Neha (security) for tech and Marcus (ops) for access. Rishi — can you confirm procurement (SOW + PO) status so we can commit dates?

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Compliance (Interim) | Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com
From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@cyphersec.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-03T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: CypherSec preliminary findings + access confirmation

Evelyn / team,

We completed the first phase of testing for the Dec window and attached a preliminary report (CypherSec_Prelim_Report_20261203.pdf). Summary: two high-severity issues (one auth bypass vector on staging, one misconfigured CORS policy on payment partner endpoint), several medium findings, and a handful of low/noise items.

Deliverables attached: preliminary PDF (redacted PII), CSV of findings, and screenshots for repro. We have not yet produced the final remediation attestation — we'll draft that after remediation confirmation.

Access note: we used the staging service account you provided and validated the short-lived key rotation. Please confirm if you want the staging creds rotated now.

Questions for you: 
- For the auth bypass, we have a PoC that includes a test curl sequence and a screenshot — should we open a Jira ticket in your tracker or share our PoC as a standalone file to preserve your triage flow?
- For the partner endpoint CORS issue, remediation will require partner coordination. Do you want us to share our repro with the partner directly? 

I've quoted the prior thread below for context.

Attachments: CypherSec_Prelim_Report_20261203.pdf (report stub), findings_export_20261203.csv, screenshots.zip (listed)

Regards,
Oliver Grant
CypherSec Ltd
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-04T09:26:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: CypherSec preliminary findings — need remediation plan and commercial decision

Neha / Marcus — forwarding the vendor prelim. Two quick asks from GTM/procurement: 

- Neha: can you prioritize an initial remediation estimate (ETA for high fixes)? Compliance needs this for the SOC 2 timeline.
- Marcus: if remediation impacts partner coordination, who owns notifying the partner (ops or customer success)?

Also, procurement may ask CypherSec for a one-week extension to finalize the SOW versus applying a late-delivery credit. I'm inclined to avoid credits if we can get fixes in-house quickly. Thoughts?

--- Reply thread ---
Neha: "We can triage auth bypass Monday, I expect a hotfix within 72 hours after root cause."
Marcus: "I'll open a partner ticket and request a call; ops will own the partner notif."

Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@cyphersec.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-05T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: CypherSec preliminary findings + final deliverables and attestation request

Oliver — thank you for the early analysis and the artifacts. A few action items to close out so we can satisfy SOC 2 / SIG intake: 

1) Final report: please deliver the final PDF with full technical appendix and the executive summary separated. The executive summary will go to our auditors (AICPA scoping).

2) Signed remediation attestation: we require a one-page signed attestation stating CypherSec conducted the engagement on the nominated dates and that findings were observed as described. Please include your company registration and a point of contact for auditors.

3) Evidence bundle: CSV export mapped to our tracker, screenshots (redacted where PII), and test checklist. Please upload to the Drive link below or respond to this thread with a downloadable artifact. We will import the CSV to our tracker and tag items as fixed / in progress.

Drive link for uploads: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcD_example_pen_test_docs

4) Jira: if you can create tickets in our JIRA project (SEC-xxxx series) that would speed triage; otherwise we will create them and attach your PoCs. Please indicate your preference.

5) Credentials: attaching credential_instructions.txt with our ephemeral user info and a reminder to rotate keys post-validation.

We will provide a remediation_tracker_20261205.csv back to you once we mark status. BrightTrade's security team is copied and expects the signed attestation for their audit window. Please confirm ETA for the final report and attestation by EOD 2026-12-07.

Attachments referenced: credential_instructions.txt

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Compliance (Interim) | Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com
